name: Devlok Katha

voice.description: Aman speaks in a deep, bold, low-pitched and commanding documentary narrator voice, with confident, slightly dramatic expression, at a moderate pace. The recording is very clear and close-sounding, with no background noise.
voice._about: owner, 7 Nov 2026: 'aman-bold is good. Moving forward, we'll use that for DK as well' (LL's voice; dk-aman samples)
voice._before: Divya until 7 Nov 2026; scripts voiced before then carry her voice in their own "voice"

art_style: photorealistic cinematic Indian mythology scene, realistic faces and skin, expressive emotion, dramatic volumetric light, rich saturated colour, epic, ultra detailed, sharp focus, every figure modestly dressed, one head and two arms each unless the deity has more, every banner, scroll and stone plain without any lettering
art_negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, cartoon, anime, flat illustration, deformed hands, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands, distorted face, disfigured, ugly, blurry, low quality, nsfw, revealing clothes, blood, gore, duplicate figure, two heads, extra head, extra face, stacked figures, merged faces, clones, repeated people, bad eyes, crossed eyes, asymmetric eyes

sfx._about: owner, 6 Nov 2026: the opening hits (impact) instead of a calm bell ("not hooking"); the bell stays on the reveal
